limitations: 自有与外部独立分母；游戏版本自有未记录，保持unknown，不能称v0.111精确对照。
进阶分列；采用冻结外部模型回分，未再拟合或由开发定义流派。终局簇含结局信息。
自有结果是最终记录结果；SL重试/预判必死证据另分层，未见重试证据不等于证明未SL。首次尝试截止代理另记，不把最终牌组当首次失败牌组。
逐层/改牌快照是真实日志决策点；中间缺帧未知，首次记录到不等于实际首次获得。
战斗沿原logdb视图：first combat frame为首记录帧，未必动作前；SL同层可能合并尝试，触及战斗不据合并数据计算单次HP损失。
防御仅同一固定目录正block牌副本代理；间接防御、未知ID和历史版本对齐不补造。
外部前节点HP、还原时间线与自有逐层快照口径不完全等价；ordinal不是已核floor，不相减解释成晚几层。
关联与样本差异不证明因果；自有代码/大脑/学习版本演变、SL、玩家选择和幸存偏差保留。
question_scope: 原logdb抽取的题型/选项/选择/理由（可能已按原抽取器截长），不是全部原生prompt；off/len可定位冻结源行。

rows.archetype: Efficient early damage into poison and dexterity defense
rows.summary: Add efficient damage first, then poison scaling and dexterity-supported defense. Preserve gold and health; take elites when damage and potions support them. Upgrade core cards when healthy.

rows.archetype: Kunai shivs and dexterity defense with sustained poison
rows.summary: Use Footwork and Kunai to sustain defense while poison finishes long fights. Seek shiv generation and poison scaling, not more generic attacks. Smith while healthy; heal before the boss if depleted.

rows.archetype: Free attacks and draw fuel Kunai, Afterimage, and poison
rows.summary: Use free Strikes to trigger Kunai and Afterimage while reserving energy for defense and draw. Buy cycling and scaling at shops. Remove ordinary Defends, retain the replayed copy, and take one supported elite.

rows.archetype: Free attacks fuel Kunai defense, Rolling Boulder, and Body Slam
rows.summary: Prioritize cycling to establish scaling powers reliably. Free attacks grow Kunai defense; block powers Body Slam while Boulder supplies sustained damage. Remove ordinary Defends, retain the replayed copy, and avoid additional elites.

rows.archetype: Shared Maul scaling with Kunai defense and Rolling Boulder
rows.summary: Replace weak cards with four shared-scaling Mauls. Prioritize cycling and efficient defense, retain free Strikes and replayed Defend. Take three campfires and one mandatory elite; prepare resources for consecutive bosses.

rows.archetype: Maul and Boulder scaling with Kunai defense and fast cycling
rows.summary: Recovery is urgent. Keep the shop route and avoid additional fights. Prioritize potions and efficient draw over marginal cards or removals; retain free Strikes and replayed Defend. Scale Mauls behind Kunai defense.
